paragraphs: By way of introduction, my name is Joshua Chappell. My intent is to apply for the Social Content Creator position at Cardone Ventures. I feel I have a lot of immediate value I can bring to your organization.

Your posting asks for someone confident behind the camera and in the edit. That is the work I have done for seven years. At Grand Canyon Education I delivered 200+ videos over two years that reached millions on TV, paid social, and organic channels. At Charter One I created and led a video initiative that raised click-through rates for running ads by over 200%, and a social content initiative that earned more than 20x the engagement of standard content. I shoot with the final edit in mind, then cut the footage myself. I have partnered with CEOs and executives on projects, so filming leadership is familiar ground. I keep assets organized in Frame.io and Dropbox, which cut search and retrieval time by over 50% and let other editors find what they need. I also build AI content workflows that cut production times in half, and that speed matters when same-day event content is due.
I appreciate that you value being inspirational, accountable, transparent, disciplined, aligned, and results oriented; these are all values that I strive to emulate.
Thank you for taking the time out of your busy day to read my letter. I look forward to the opportunity of doing an interview with you.

why: He shoots and edits his own footage, which is exactly what the posting asks for. He has 7+ years (they ask for 5+) on three professional camera systems: Sony FX3/FX6, Canon and RED.
He has every editing tool they name: Premiere Pro (required) plus After Effects, DaVinci Resolve and Frame.io (preferred).

He has short-form results with numbers behind them (20x engagement, 200%+ click-through lift at Charter One). His AI workflows cut production time in half, and AI efficiency is one of the posting's stated objectives.

He has executive and high-volume experience: CEOs at Lightbox, RFK Jr. and the AZ Speaker of the House at the Legislature, and 200+ videos in two years at GCE. Photography, which the posting calls a plus, is also covered.
gaps: Podcast production. The posting mentions podcasts five times, and he has no podcast credits. Answer: "I haven't produced a podcast series, but I've shot multicam, properly lit and mic'd interviews for years. A podcast is a locked multicam interview with sustained audio, so it's the same skill set."

Teleprompter shoots. They are listed as a competency but are not in his record. Answer: "I haven't run a teleprompter shoot yet, but I've directed talent on camera for seven years, and the setup is quick to learn."

Asana. They name it; he has used Wrike, Notion, Trello and Workamajig. Answer: "I've run projects in four tracking tools. Asana works the same way and I can be up to speed in a day." (Asana Academy is free.)
Captions and sound design are named deliverables but not spelled out on the resume. Answer: "I do both on every social cut in Premiere and Audition. Here's an example." Have one ready.

reference.jd_text:
Social Content Creator


Salary Range: $85,000 to $100,000 per year

Onsite Location: Scottsdale, AZ

Workplace Location: Fully Onsite


POSITION SUMMARY

As a Social Media Content Creator you will independently capture, edit, organize, and help produce high-quality long-form and short-form content for our brands, campaigns, events, podcasts, and executive thought leadership.

This is a film-heavy, editing-forward role for a skilled creator who understands professional content capture, visual storytelling, and modern social media. You will film across studio shoots, executive sessions, events, travel, and day-to-day brand opportunities while partnering with Social Media and Production to deliver polished, platform-ready content.

The ideal candidate is confident behind the camera and in the edit. They can operate equipment independently, make strong creative decisions in real time, capture footage with the final story in mind, and turn raw footage into high-performing content that is ready for distribution.

You are proactive, highly organized, visually skilled, and comfortable working in fast-moving production environments. You bring a strong point of view while remaining collaborative, adaptable, and committed to delivering work that meets a high creative standard.


ABOUT CARDONE VENTURES

Our mission is to help business owners achieve their personal, professional, and financial goals through the growth of their businesses. We work in dozens of verticals and provide strategic business guidance through courses, live events, partnerships, and investments. Our core values are the backbone of our business and guide our hiring process: we are inspirational, accountable, transparent, disciplined, aligned, and results oriented. This company operates nationally and is growing by the day.

SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Founders, executives, and internal teams have a seamless, professional filming experience because shoots are prepared, organized, and executed with care.
Long-form, short-form, podcast, event, and executive content is captured at a consistently high visual standard.
Raw footage is thoughtfully captured with the final edit in mind, giving editors and social teams the angles, coverage, B-roll, and visual variety needed to create strong-performing content.
Assigned edits are delivered as polished, platform-native assets that align with brand standards and content objectives.
Footage is organized, labeled, and delivered in a way that allows editors, vendors, and internal teams to quickly locate and use assets.
The creator proactively identifies opportunities to improve framing, lighting, camera angles, audio, visual details, pacing, storytelling, and production quality.
Same-day event content and social-first assets are captured, edited, and delivered quickly when needed.
The creator brings strong editorial judgment and production insight that strengthens content performance across platforms.

OBJECTIVES

Partner with Social Media and Production teams to execute the creative vision for executive, brand, podcast, event, campaign, and social content.
Independently capture high-quality long-form and short-form video content, including teleprompter-based videos, talking-head content, interviews, podcasts, B-roll, behind-the-scenes footage, vlogs, event coverage, and social-first assets.
Operate cameras, lighting, audio, teleprompters, and related production equipment during studio shoots, on-location shoots, executive sessions, and live events.
Prepare for shoots by reviewing production direction, understanding content goals, following shot lists, and anticipating the coverage needed for final edits.
Proactively identify additional footage, angles, visual moments, and storytelling opportunities that strengthen the final product.
Independently edit polished short-form and select long-form video content, including social clips, trailers, recaps, podcast promotions, executive thought-leadership content, announcements, and timely brand opportunities.
Create engaging, platform-native edits with strong pacing, visual storytelling, music, sound design, captions, basic motion graphics, color correction, and formatting appropriate for each channel.
Collaborate with editors, vendors, and internal teams while owning assigned projects from raw footage through final delivery, including selects, B-roll, revisions, and delivery specifications.
Organize, label, upload, and archive footage in a highly structured manner using approved asset-management systems.
Leverage AI technologies and workflow tools to improve production efficiency, organization, editing, and team collaboration.
Stay current on social media trends, filming techniques, editing styles, camera technology, lighting, and platform-native content practices.
Support content capture during travel and live events as needed.

COMPETENCIES

Advanced experience producing, filming, and editing video content for digital platforms.
Strong understanding of camera operation, framing, composition, visual storytelling, lighting, and audio.
Proven ability to capture footage with strong editorial judgment and an understanding of what will perform in the final edit.
Experience filming and editing long-form content, executive content, interviews, podcasts, events, branded campaigns, or social-first content.
Ability to confidently lead or support teleprompter-based shoots and work effectively in fast-moving live-production environments.
Advanced editing ability, including pacing, storytelling, sound design, music selection, captioning, basic motion graphics, color correction, and platform-native formatting.
Strong understanding of short-form content performance, including hooks, retention, visual variety, pacing, and audience-first storytelling.
Ability to independently take a project from shot list through capture, edit, revision, and final delivery while maintaining brand standards and meeting deadlines.
Strong organizational skills, including footage management, file naming, asset archiving, project tracking, and handoffs to editors, vendors, and internal teams.
Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, including Premiere Pro. Experience with After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, Frame.io, and other editing or collaboration tools is strongly preferred.
Ability to create selects, clips, supporting assets, and clear project handoffs for editors and social teams.
Strong attention to detail, including identifying and resolving preventable visual, audio, and continuity issues before or during a shoot.
Ability to collaborate effectively with Social Media, Production, Paid Media, Sales, external vendors, and executive talent.
Ability to innovate with modern filming and social-content techniques while maintaining strong brand standards.
Knowledge of current social media trends, camera and lighting technology, and production practices that support engagement and performance.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

At least 5 years of professional experience in videography, filmmaking, video editing, content creation, production, or a related field.
Portfolio required, including examples that demonstrate both high-quality videography and finished editing work (Long form content, interviews, podcast, events, branded campaigns, etc).
Experience operating professional camera equipment is required. Experience across multiple camera systems is strongly preferred.
Experience editing content in a high-volume brand, agency, production, media, event, or executive-content environment is strongly preferred.
Experience creating polished, fast-turn social content in a deadline-driven environment is strongly preferred.
Photography experience is a plus, particularly for events, lifestyle, executive, or behind-the-scenes content.
Experience with project-management and asset-management tools such as Asana, Frame.io, cloud storage, or similar platforms is preferred.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
Ability to lift, carry, set up, and break down camera equipment and production gear.
Ability to travel at least twice per quarter or based on business needs, work on-site for events, shoots, and executive content sessions as needed.
Must be on-site at our Scottsdale, AZ office; this is not a remote role

COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY

As an equal opportunity employer committed to meeting the needs of a multigenerational and multicultural workforce Cardone Ventures recognizes that a diverse staff, reflective of our community, is an integral and welcome part of a successful and ethical business. We hire local talent at all levels regardless of race, color, religion, age, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation or disability, and actively foster inclusion in all forms both within our company and across interactions with clients, candidates and partners.

Cardone Ventures uses AI-assisted tools as part of our recruiting process. These tools may be used to support resume screening, candidate outreach, or initial assessments. All hiring decisions are made by our People team and hiring managers. If you have questions about our process please contact us.

If this position caught your eye, send us your resume! For best consideration, include the job title and source where you found this position in the subject line of your email to careers @cardoneventures.com. Already a Cardone Ventures candidate? Please connect directly with your recruiter to discuss this opportunity.

Equal Opportunity Employer
This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

research.overview: Cardone Ventures is a business consulting and coaching company. It sells courses, runs live events, and makes partnerships and investments for business owners. CB Insights says it was founded in 2019. Brandon Dawson is CEO and co-founder with Grant Cardone. It has offices in Scottsdale, AZ and Aventura, FL (Miami area). Sites give headcounts anywhere from 51-200 to 251-500. All the review data below is company-wide: it mixes Scottsdale and Florida staff, and sales, events, finance, HR and marketing roles. Few reviews come from video or creative staff. The ones found are two Indeed video editor reviews (a critical one from September 2026 and a positive one from Miami in January 2025), one Glassdoor video editor review (Aventura, May 2025, positive), and a Glassdoor Marketing Manager page with only 2 reviews. I took the ratings and counts from search-engine snapshots, not the live pages, and they differ by date: Glassdoor shows 152 to 190 reviews and Indeed 64 to 72. Several of the harshest Glassdoor reviews are from 2022-2024. Don't confuse Cardone Ventures with Cardone Capital or Grant Cardone Enterprises (separate Cardone companies) or with Cardone Industries (an unrelated auto-parts maker).

glassdoor.rating: 4.2 / 5 (work-life balance 3.6, the lowest sub-score; compensation and benefits 4.0; 80% would recommend; about 90% approve of CEO Brandon Dawson)
glassdoor.summary: Company-wide, not team-specific. Reviews are sharply split. Positive reviews mention mentorship, investment in employee development, about three weeks of onboarding focused on values and culture, good coworkers, and a 'work hard, play hard' feel. Negative reviews (several from 2022-2024, titled 'Do Not Work Here', 'Avoid this place', 'Honest Review Please Stay Clear') describe long hours and weekend work, very high turnover, constant changes to procedures and processes, a 'cult like' culture, and a required daily CardoneU video task. One 2024 reviewer says the culture has gone downhill since 2021. The only video-role review found (Aventura, FL, May 2025) is positive: it praises team leads and says the company keeps its gear current. Glassdoor's interview data says Video Editor hires are made fastest (about 1 day on average).

indeed.summary: Company-wide, about 71-72 reviews (one snapshot said 64), so a small sample. A social media coordinator praised a supportive team, strong growth, and good benefits. A sales rep said the job pays well but expects weekend work plus extra time for 2-3 day events. An event coordinator said leadership judged employees and customers on appearance. A 2026 Scottsdale sales review said the company does not like the term 'work-life balance'. The newest review (September 2026) is from a video editor. It describes a high-pressure culture and says much of the job was making content that showed the owner and company as more successful than things felt inside. A January 2025 video editor review from Miami was positive (high-energy, supportive, performance-focused). The Indeed connector was down, so I could not pull company data directly.

reddit.summary: No Reddit threads about working at Cardone Ventures came up in several standard and extended searches. The closest thing was a post on Fishbowl (a different anonymous work forum) from a job seeker asking if anyone had worked there. The only visible reply warned about the Grant Cardone name and gave no first-hand detail.

pros.point: Good overall scores on both big review sites: about 4.2 on Glassdoor (about 190 reviews, 80% would recommend) and 4.5 on Indeed (about 71 reviews). These cover the whole company, not the content team.
Several reviewers praise mentorship, investment in employee development, and a long onboarding (about three weeks of training on values and culture).
People who want fast growth describe a supportive, motivated team with room to advance. A social media coordinator on Indeed mentioned good opportunities and benefits.

Video staff reviews are partly positive. A 2025 Aventura, FL editor praised team leads and said the company keeps its gear and equipment current. A January 2025 Miami video editor on Indeed called the culture high-energy and supportive. Both are from Florida, not Scottsdale.
Pay and benefits score fine: Glassdoor compensation and benefits is 4.0, and an Indeed sales reviewer said the job pays well. This posting lists $85,000-$100,000.
Reviewers say the mission and values are clear and actually used, which matches the values listed in the posting. This review looks older.
Hiring for video roles has been fast. Glassdoor's interview data says Video Editor hires happen quickest, about 1 day on average.

cons.point: Work-life balance is the lowest score and the most common complaint: long hours, weekend work, and extra days for 2-3 day events. A 2026 Scottsdale review says the company does not like the term 'work-life balance'.
Turnover is reported as high, with frequent changes to procedures and processes. One 2024 reviewer described 20+ people leaving in under six months and said things have declined since 2021.

The newest review in this job family (Indeed, September 2026, video editor) describes high pressure and says much of the work was promotional content that made the owner and company look more successful than things felt inside.

Some negative reviews are harsh about leadership and culture ('cult like', 'Do Not Work Here', 'Avoid this place'). A 2022 Scottsdale reviewer criticized the pay plan, onboarding and leadership and said base pay was low for the market. Most of these are from 2022-2024.
Some reviewers say they worked overtime and weekends without pay, or that commissions came slowly. Most of these are sales roles and may not apply to a salaried creative job.
Reviewers mention a required daily CardoneU video task, said to be at least 15 minutes a day with termination possible if missed, on top of the regular workload.
An Indeed event coordinator said leadership judged employees and customers mostly on appearance.

red_flags: The most relevant review for this job is the newest one: a September 2026 video editor on Indeed who describes high pressure and making content that oversold the company. It is one review, but it is from this job family.
Reports of high turnover (for example, 20+ people leaving in under six months in 2024) appear in several Glassdoor reviews.

Legal news around the brand. Cardone Ventures and 10X Health Ventures sued former executives Gary Brecka and Sage Workinger in federal court in Miami (trademark and breach of executive agreements; amended complaint filed February 2025, in discovery). Separately, Cardone Capital, a different Grant Cardone company, has investor litigation (Ark7 reports a class action certified in March 2026). None of these are claims against Cardone Ventures by employees.
The Social Content Creator posting did not show up on any indexed job board or in Dice on 2026-10-14, and Indeed could not be checked. It may have closed.
research.bottom_line: On paper the ratings are good (about 4.2 on Glassdoor, 4.5 on Indeed), but reviews split sharply. People who want a high-intensity, growth-focused place rate it well. Complaints center on long hours, weekend and event work, turnover, and a demanding, brand-driven culture. This role is fully onsite, includes same-day event turnarounds, and requires travel at least twice a quarter, so expect the intense side. The most recent video editor review is critical. It is still worth interviewing. Ask directly: what does a normal week look like, and an event week? How long has the content team been together? How are weekend events handled for salaried staff?
